core.fantasy: You are an upstart boss who grows a tiny farm into a region-spanning logistics empire, one route and one district at a time.
pillars: Production chains you can see moving on the map
Expansion district by district, each with its own loyalty
Pressure that grows with success, so growth must be managed
core.signature_moment: Zooming out to see trucks streaming from plantations through labs and warehouses to an airfield, the whole chain humming, just before pressure forces you to reroute.
anti_goals: no city-building aesthetics for their own sake

signatures.description: Raw goods are grown, carried by visible vehicles to processing buildings, stored, then carried to export points; every link is a building or a route on the map.
Earnings arrive in a currency you can't spend directly and must convert through slower front businesses before you can build.
Activity raises attention per district; high attention brings raids that disrupt the chain unless you spread out or lie low.
The map is divided into towns and districts you take over one at a time; each unlocks land, buildings and new routes.
Named lieutenants with traits run parts of the operation; when the leader falls, one of them takes over and play continues.
A fictionalised 1980s Latin American drug-trade setting, with its characters, comic-style portraits, story and soundtrack.

take.setting: Ranch supply chains: fields and animals produce raw goods (wheat, milk, wool, apples), workshops turn them into products (bread, cheese, yarn, pies), carts carry them along roads to a market stall or the station.
Bottlenecks are the puzzle: barns and carts have capacity, so a child sees goods pile up and fixes it by building another cart or a bigger barn.
Two kinds of reward: coins from selling, and 'thank-you stars' from neighbours you deliver to. Stars unlock new building types; coins build them.
Expansion by valleys: helping a neighbouring valley (delivering what it asks for) opens its land, new crops and a new road.
Gentle pressure instead of raids: the weather and the seasons (a rainy week floods a road, winter slows fields), so players spread out and plan ahead. Nothing is lost; things just slow down.
Ranch hands with traits (fast, careful, loves animals) run a building or a cart; one can be put in charge of a valley.
Zoom-out 'whole valley' view that shows every cart moving along its road, the payoff shot of a working chain.

leave: the drug, crime, violence, police and corruption theme, entirely
money laundering as a concept (the two rewards are gifts and coins, nothing hidden)
raids, rival gangs and any loss of what the player built
leader death and succession (helpers can be promoted, nobody dies)
its characters, setting, art, music and text

profiles.name: 9 Kings
profiles.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

profiles.name: Dorfromantik
profiles.short_description: Dorfromantik is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you create a beautiful and ever-growing village landscape by placing tiles. Explore a variety of colorful biomes, discover and unlock new tiles and complete quests to fill your world with life!

profiles.name: LEGO® Bricktales
profiles.short_description: In this puzzle-adventure, use an intuitive brick-by-brick building mechanic to solve puzzles and bring your creations to life! Experience a charming story as you explore beautiful LEGO® dioramas and help the people inhabiting them.

profiles.name: Tiny Glade
profiles.short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.
